caribbean.headline: Caribbean Winds Pick Up
caribbean.paragraph: Curacao is experiencing 17 kt winds with a 50% rain probability, while waves are reaching 4.7 ft in height. Aruba is seeing slightly stronger winds at 21 kt, with less than 10% rain probability, as a high-pressure system dominates the region.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Winds Rise
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing 23 kt winds with 7.3 ft wave heights and less than 10% rain probability, while Naples has relatively calmer conditions with 12 kt winds. I expect these winds to impact maritime activities in the Eastern Mediterranean, particularly around Mykonos, due to the elevated wave heights and moderate wind speeds.
